status: BASE + 4G UPLINK, built from vendored source. NOT yet hardware-verified. GNSS, camera and SD still NOT present.
summary: Flash the ESP32-S3 router firmware directly from the browser. No command line or Python installation required.
upstream_license: NOT DECLARED - upstream repo has no LICENSE file and GitHub reports license=null. Only the vendored WireGuard submodule carries an explicit BSD-style licence. Redistribution terms must be clarified with the author before any product release.
base_note: Built from the vendored esp32_nat_router 2.4.17 source in this repository. On top of the base this image adds an explicit uplink selector (WiFi vs A7670E 4G over UART) with a /modem web page, an A7670E PPP driver (components/modem_4g) and RGB status signalling (docs/product/led-signals.md). AP SSID still broadcasts NomadLink; mDNS hostname nomadlink.local. GNSS, camera and SD are not yet in this image.
prereq_note: Recommended: Chrome, Edge or Opera. Close all other serial monitors first. Browser flashing writes bootloader, partition table, otadata and app.

verification.manifest_and_binaries_served: PASS - HTTP 200 for manifest and all four parts at the declared offsets. Sizes for this build: 17664 / 3072 / 8192 / 1428944 bytes.
verification.actual_flash_to_device: PASS for 0.1.0-base.1 ONLY (TEST-810, 2026-10-01) - flashed by the project owner from the published web installer; AP broadcast SSID 'NomadLink'. The 0.2.0-4g.1 image has NOT been flashed by anyone yet.
verification.on_device_runtime: PASS for the BASE PATH ONLY - boots, broadcasts 'NomadLink', and a client behind the AP reaches the internet (owner-confirmed, TEST-810), so SoftAP + DHCP + NAPT + forwarding + WiFi STA uplink all work. NOT verified for 0.2.0-4g.1: nothing in this image has run on hardware. Not measured anywhere: throughput in Mbps, load behaviour.

toolchain: ESP-IDF 5.5.x (installed at ~/esp/esp-idf-5.5.4). The base does NOT build on IDF 6.x: main requires component 'json', which moved to the component manager.
stage_command: make stage-firmware  (rebuilds and re-stages the served payload; offsets verified against build_esp32s3/flash_args)

branding.firmware_artifact: nomadlink.bin (IDF project renamed from upstream's esp32_nat_router)
branding.note: The MQTT topic prefix stays esp32_nat_router: it is a functional broker identifier, not branding, and renaming it would break existing subscriptions.

reproducibility: NOT byte-reproducible, by upstream design: CMakeLists.txt force-rebuilds esp_app_desc.c so __DATE__/__TIME__ stay current. Two builds of identical source differ in ~67 bytes of the app descriptor only, same length. Do not treat a hash mismatch as a corrupt payload; the freshness guard is timestamp-based for this reason.
ui_present_in_base: /config (full config incl. uplink ssid/password, static IP, AP settings)
ui_still_to_build: Failover policy decision: when 4G is selected but the dial fails, does the router fall back to WiFi (current code) or keep retrying 4G? Owner has not chosen.
Ethernet uplink (the UPLINK_ETH mode exists in code but no board interface is wired)
